headline: Security Debates Surround Crypto Exchanges After $6.3 Billion Binance Breach
summary: The $6.3 billion breach at Binance has revived debates over whether cryptocurrency exchanges are less secure than traditional banks or more difficult to protect once breached.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Security vulnerabilities in major trading platforms pose systemic and operational risks for digital asset investors.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Binance is the primary entity impacted by security debates following its breach.
